expectations.name: adds-srd-keys-to-a-starter-config
expected_behavior: Shows the whole proposed front matter and asks before writing anything
The proposal names `conflu/srd` for `initiatives` and the guidelines document for `srd-standard`

Writes `kb: kb`, `initiatives: conflu/srd`, `srd-standard: conflu/doc/infraport/guidelines_for_software_requirements_documents.md`, `glossary: conflu/doc/infraport/glossary`, `gaps: gap`, and `srd-work: srd-work` into `project-config.md`
Keeps `mcp-server: docs`, `mcp-port: 7791`, `watch: true`, and the body as found, and adds `kb` to `sources`
Appends the key reference (`## Front matter keys`, copied verbatim) after the kept body

expectations.name: writes-a-whole-file-without-one
expected_behavior: Gives the new file the body `# Project configuration` followed by the key reference

expectations.name: stops-when-already-set-up
expected_behavior: Says the folder is already set up, in one or two lines

expectations.name: check-describes-a-sound-setup
expected_behavior: Gives the trust order with `kb` first, then `docs/api`

expectations.name: check-flags-misplaced-folders
expected_behavior: Names `srd-work` in `sources` as a problem, with the fix to remove it
Names `kb` missing from `sources` as a problem, with the fix to add it
